submarket: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"

finding.headline: "Six Months Out and Still Look Pregnant"
finding.problem: "My friend had her baby naturally and is in crop tops. Me, cut open, still look 5 months pregnant. I avoid cameras. I feel broken."
finding.recurring_situation: HIDDEN MARKET — "How do I function normally again after a C-section while caring for a newborn?"
finding.person: A 34-yr-old mom; diastasis + shelf; friends who had vaginal births "snapped back"; she hides under Ankara gowns and avoids photos.
finding.competition_notes: See RESEARCH BASE section of source report.

disposition.rationale: Report assigns: "Marketing angle for D1/D2; cross-sell Postpartum Body Confidence.". Verdict: PASSES (5/5).
